sequence_description: I2 expiry enforcement: run a valid control password login, then attempt SAML login with an expired assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) for a different identity; verify expired assertion is rejected and does not create an active session.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_expired_saml_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_expired_saml_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Expired SAML assertion was accepted (login succeeded) — freshness/expiry enforcement failure.

sequence_description: I2 replay: perform a control password login, then perform a forged SAML login with a fixed Assertion/@ID (no OneTimeUse), and replay the same Assertion/@ID again; verify the second login is rejected (anti-replay).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Replayed SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) was accepted — anti-replay failure.

sequence_description: Use a valid access token as subject_token for token exchange (control), revoke the subject token session, then attempt token exchange again with the revoked subject token to test whether revocation is enforced for token-exchange inputs.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_after_revoke_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_after_revoke_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange accepted a revoked access token as subject_token (revocation not enforced for token-exchange inputs).

sequence_description: Attempt an expired forged SAML assertion first (should be rejected), then immediately attempt a non-expired assertion reusing the same Assertion/@ID to test whether Casdoor incorrectly marks the ID as consumed even when the first attempt was rejected (DoS-style anti-replay bug) or incorrectly accepts the expired one.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_expired_attempt_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_expired_attempt_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Expired SAML assertion was accepted (freshness/expiry enforcement failure).

sequence_description: SAML OneTimeUse replay: login with a forged assertion that includes OneTimeUse and a fixed Assertion/@ID, then replay the same Assertion/@ID to test whether Casdoor enforces one-time consumption.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replayed SAML assertion with OneTimeUse / same Assertion ID (anti-replay failure).

sequence_description: Token exchange replay: obtain a subject access token via password login, then perform token exchange twice using the same subject_token to test whether Casdoor incorrectly treats token exchange as one-time or allows replay when it should be constrained by policy.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_2_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_2_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange accepted the same subject_token repeatedly (potential replay/over-minting of derived tokens).

sequence_description: Config-change + re-auth: perform a control SAML login, then change the application configuration to disable SAML assertion signature enforcement (or toggle SAML binding settings), and attempt to replay the same assertion ID to see if anti-replay state is lost across config changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_cfg_replay_after_change_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_cfg_replay_after_change_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replayed SAML assertion after an application config change (anti-replay state lost or bypassed).
